results.releaseNotes:
A huge update for race day on your wrist.

With the new Apple Watch app, you can now see every stage of your drive directly on your wrist. Keep track of time and delta as you go without reaching for your phone.

Introducing the new Delta Bar: a clear, real-time visual showing how far ahead or behind you are versus your selected target. As you ride, the Delta Bar updates continuously so you can adjust your pace immediately.

You can now also connect your Race Box device via Bluetooth for improved, more accurate GPS tracking. That means better location data throughout your entire drive, helping your performance insights stay reliable.
results.description:
Introducing Rally Co-Pilot, your Ultimate Classic Car Rally Companion!

Are you ready to leave your competitors in the dust at your next classic, regularity, TSD (time speed distance), or historic rally? Rally Co-Pilot is the must-have app for every classic car rally enthusiast, providing you with an unparalleled edge to excel in every race.

Rally Co-Pilot is packed with features designed to help you navigate and dominate special stages with ease, including:
 - Advanced Time and Distance Management: Calculate allocated times for special stages, set countdowns, and save/manage times effortlessly
 - Apple Watch App: Check your wrist for detailed live data during your drive
 - Live Performance Feedback: Monitor your average speed, driven distance, and remaining time in real-time
 - Real-Time Position Tracking: See your position on the map to stay on track and never miss a turn
 - Smart Countdowns: Spoken countdowns or beep for crucial final seconds
 - RaceBox support: Connect with your RaceBox tracker for an enhanced and more reliable GPS connection
 - Dual Measurement Support: Works seamlessly in both miles and kilometers
 - Unlimited Stopwatches and Countdowns: Stay in control of your time, every time
 - Find Classic Rallies: The app lists many classic rallies all across the globe

*Please note: Rally Co-Pilot requires location access to provide real-time positioning, speed, and distance calculations. This may affect battery life. Always check the race regulations to ensure helper tools are permitted by stewards to avoid disqualification.


Payment and subscriptions

The app requires a subscription, that will be charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. If you do not turn off auto-renew, your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Cancellation of the current subscription during the active period is not possible.

You can read more about our terms and conditions here: https://www.philippbaldauf.com/terms
And about our privacy policy here: https://www.philippbaldauf.com/privacy
